newsitem.title: FRANCE: Chirac to pledge steady policy course on TV.
newsitem.headline: Chirac to pledge steady policy course on TV.

text.p: French President Jacques Chirac will reassert a steady policy course for the centre-right government in a television interview on Thursday and trace his view of society into the 21st century, officials said.
Chirac's hour-long interview, at 1950 GMT on the eve of a European Union summit, will be his first major television interview since July 14.
"We are living through a transitional period and the president has the tough task of leading the country in a switch towards modernity," one official said.
